# References

Based on the FAIR data principles and community research data management guidance (The Turing Way, ELIXIR RDMkit).

Learn more:

- https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/ - the FAIR principles
- https://the-turing-way.netlify.app/reproducible-research/rdm - The Turing Way chapter on research data management
- https://rdmkit.elixir-europe.org - ELIXIR RDMkit, per-domain and per-task RDM guidance
- https://fairsharing.org - registry of metadata standards and data repositories
- https://zenodo.org - general-purpose data repository with DOIs
- https://dvc.org - Data Version Control
- https://www.datalad.org - DataLad dataset management
